verdict.rationale: Algolia ships Agent Studio, which grounds LLM responses in live Algolia index data to produce shopping assistants, content summarizers, and conversational search, plus a separate ML-based Recommend engine and Personalization for AI-driven suggestions, and Search Analytics for data-driven insights (popular searches, CTR, no-results). These are first-party features squarely matching 'AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence validating Agent Studio's actual output quality, and no community corroboration specifically of Recommend/Personalization/Agent Studio (only search relevance is discussed in community threads).
